  7. Ditirambo - located in the historical center, offers a high-quality menu with fresh and seasonal ingredients.

- [FACT] User is interested in gelato spots in Rome.
- [ASSISTANT] Recommended gelato spots in Rome:
  1. Giolitti - one of the oldest gelaterias, offers classic flavors and seasonal specialties.
  2. Fatamorgana - focuses on high-quality and unique ingredients for unusual gelato flavors.
  3. Gelateria del Teatro - known for creative flavors and aesthetically pleasing presentation, located near Piazza Navona.
  4. La Romana - a chain known for fresh and natural ingredients with a variety of flavors.
  5. Neve di Latte - uses fresh, organic ingredients from small farms to create high-quality gelato.
